Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in biological reasoning by incorrectly assessing the environmental influence on the provided traits. Specifically, the Planner overestimated the environmental impact on "Eye color" (claiming it is affected by sun exposure) while simultaneously underestimating the massive environmental influence on "Body weight" (diet, exercise, lifestyle). In reality, eye color is almost entirely determined by genetics and does not change due to environmental factors, whereas body weight is highly plastic and directly modifiable by the environment. By declaring the task complete based on this flawed comparison without consulting external resources or specialists to verify the scientific consensus, the Planner provided the wrong answer.
